# Affinity Home Medical

> > Affinity Home Medical is a Salt Lake City-based medical supply retailer specializing in mobility aids, respiratory equipment, and home medical devices from leading brands like Medline, Pride Mobility, and Golden Technologies.

Affinity Home Medical serves patients and caregivers in Utah and beyond with a comprehensive catalog of wheelchairs, scooters, lift chairs, hospital beds, respiratory products, and medical accessories. The store combines product selection with expert guidance to help customers find solutions for mobility, accessibility, and home healthcare needs.

## Key Topics

- Mobility Aids
- Power Wheelchairs
- Power Scooters
- Hospital Beds

- Oxygen Concentrators

## Mobility & Wheelchair Solutions

- [Wheelchairs Medical Suppliers](https://affinityhomemedical.com/collections/wheelchairs): Wheelchair collection featuring standard, lightweight, and power wheelchair options.
- [Discover Comfort: Power Wheelchairs at Affinity Home Medical](https://affinityhomemedical.com/collections/power-wheel-chairs): Power wheelchair collection with full-sized, heavy-duty, and portable electric chair options.
- [Walking Aids | Walker Chair | Affinity Home Medical](https://affinityhomemedical.com/collections/walkers): Walker collection including rolling walkers, rollators, and standard walking aids.

## Scooters & Personal Mobility

- [Explore Top Power Scooters for Enhanced Mobility - Buy Now](https://affinityhomemedical.com/collections/power-scooters): Power scooter collection featuring Go-Go and Pride mobility scooters for enhanced mobility.
- [Heavy Duty Power Scooters | Affinity Home Medical](https://affinityhomemedical.com/collections/heavy-duty-power-scooters): Heavy-duty scooter options including Pride PX4 and BAJA Wrangler for extended use.
- [Discover Versatile 3-Wheel Scooters for Every User!](https://affinityhomemedical.com/collections/3-wheel-scooter): 3-wheel scooter collection from Golden Technologies with models like Victory 9.
- [Discover 3 Wheel Travel Scooters | Affinity Home Medical](https://affinityhomemedical.com/collections/3-wheel-travel-scooters): Compact 3-wheel travel scooters including folding models from Drive Medical and Medline.
- [4 wheel Scooter for everyone!!](https://affinityhomemedical.com/collections/4-wheel-scooter): 4-wheel scooter collection with stability-focused models like Cobra GT4 and Ventura.
- [4 Wheel Travel Scooters for Stability | Affinity Home Medical](https://affinityhomemedical.com/collections/4-wheel-travel-scooter): 4-wheel travel scooters from Golden Technologies offering stability and portability.

## Respiratory & Oxygen Therapy

- [Explore Top Respiratory Products for Ultimate Care](https://affinityhomemedical.com/collections/respiratory): Respiratory products including oxygen concentrators, CPAP machines, and nebulizers.
- [Stationary Oxygen Concentrators | Affinity Home Medical](https://affinityhomemedical.com/collections/stationary-concentrator): Stationary oxygen concentrators from DeVilbiss and Caire for home oxygen therapy.
- [Portable Oxygen Concentrators | Affinity Home Medical](https://affinityhomemedical.com/collections/portable-concentrators): Portable oxygen concentrators including INOGEN G5 and Rhythm P2 travel models.
- [Nebulizers & Breathing Accessories | Affinity Home Medical](https://affinityhomemedical.com/collections/nebulizers-accessories): Nebulizers and breathing accessories including mesh and compressor nebulizer options.

## Home Care Furniture & Beds

- [Comfort and Style: Explore Our Unique Lift Chairs Today!](https://affinityhomemedical.com/collections/lift-chairs): Lift chair collection featuring 3-position and zero gravity reclining furniture options.
